sam: opened PR #401 with migration note for routing defaults. I changed the example to show what happens when two variants have equal weight and included a small snippet. holding for runtime confirm before merging: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/401

liz: quick read looks good but we definitely need the exact key string. you wrote 'hash-first' in the example which probably isn't correct. can someone from runtime confirm the canonical config and the header we hash on?

omar: runtime side: canonical string is `routing.selection_strategy = \"hash_with_rr_fallback\"`. hashing uses `Idempotency-Key` then `X-Request-ID` if present. if neither header exists we use a per-worker round-robin. this isn't guaranteed to be cluster-wide deterministic.

sam: thanks. i'll update the example to use the exact string. two follow-ups: 1) should docs call out the fallback explicitly? 2) do we need to document atomicity of pinning behavior (`routing.pin_model_version`)?

omar: yes, call out fallback. for pin behavior: when `routing.pin_model_version = true` and the client supplies a variant id the runtime will bypass selection entirely and route directly. we should include that as a note and a short example snippet.

liz: CI preview failed on this branch with linkcheck and a broken anchor to the runtime RFC. ci-bot posted details.

ci-bot: Preview job failed: linkcheck error at /specs/routing#tie-breaker (404). See job: ci/previews/401

sam: ok i'll remove the dead anchor and add a short explanatory paragraph instead. omar can you add a public anchor or confirm a stable target we can link to?

omar: i'll add a small public docs anchor under runtime/docs/routing.md and ping when merged. ETA ~30 minutes. for now you can phrase it as: "Selection uses stable hashing on request id headers (Idempotency-Key, X-Request-ID) with round-robin fallback; set `routing.selection_strategy = \"hash_with_rr_fallback\"`. Use `routing.pin_model_version = true` to bypass selection."

sam: perfect. i'll update PR, re-run preview, and hold merge until runtime anchor exists and preview passes. leaving merge-on-green off for this one.

liz: thanks. tagging product docs reviewer @jane in the PR for wording check once updated.

runtime-team-bot: New runtime docs PR created: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/812 (adds public routing anchor).

sam: great, i'll re-kick preview once that merges. will also add a tiny example config block and a one-line note about non-global determinism.

liz: merging blocked until preview passes and runtime anchor is live. thanks all. :lock:
